notes.title: July 2024 Update
notes.content:
Improved the options menu to improve the user experience.

Improved mouse controls.
[list]
[*]Left-click to select and place events.
[*]When placing an event on the calendar, left-click the event list to cancel placement.
[*]Right-click to cancel in menus.
[*]Right-click to swap calendar between month and week view.
[*]Middle-click to access the pause menu.
[*]Scroll wheel to go through the event list.
[/list]

notes.title: June 2024 Update
notes.content:
A small update with support for the mouse (used with the keyboard), and updating the application icon.
Additional improvements to the mouse experience will be in an update next week.

Mouse controls:
Left-click to select and place events. (A keyboard or controller is currently required to cancel without placing an event after selection.)

Right-click to change between month and week views.

Middle-click to access the pause menu.

The scroll wheel scrolls in the event list, changes the current week/month on the calendar, and changes the month on the level selection screen.
